name: Integra Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Integra Capital Ltd provides capital market operations, mutual funds & other investments, and consultancy and advisory services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) ICL is registered as a non systematically important, not authorized to accept public deposits, Non-Banking Financial Company 
(NBFC-ND).
b) The company is also registered with the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI), enabling it to offer consolidated investment solutions to retail and institutional investors.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.3% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.15% over last 3 years.
